items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ella Fitzgerald used to keep our money for us, me, Dave, and Joe Vail

ctx.x: Do you have any particular memories of certain people or certain concerts or certain things that happened to you across that time in your life when you were still so young and having the chance to work with Dizzy Gillespie? Anything special from that time you remember you'd like to talk about?
Oh, there were a lot of things like Ella Fitzgerald used to keep our money for us, me, Dave, and Joe Vail [phonetic sp.].
